name: @agent-engine/agent-intel-report
description: The Intel Report agent (RFC-05) — one BaseAgent (IntelReportDraftAgent) plus its Layer 1 workflow, built entirely on Phase 1's core/tools/workflow packages, following the same recipe as the LinkedIn agent. Deliberately decoupled from the SEO/GEO workflow (RFC-05 §2) — this package never imports or triggers it.
